channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Doggy Don't Care
item.description: What does your dog get up to when you're not home? In this bone-afide adventure, unleash adorable chaos, solve puzzles, and leave your mark (literally!) as a mischievous pup on the loose.

item.title: Muse Dash - Muse Plus
item.description: The movement of our world has been adapted.Can you hear my whispering? Now Game Start!!——

item.title: s&box
item.description: S&box is a game creation platform built on the Source 2 engine. Play, create, and share games, explore community creations, and experience endless sandbox fun with powerful modern tools.

item.title: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition
item.description: The Outer Worlds: Spacer’s Choice Edition is the ultimate way to play the award-winning RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. Including the base game and all DLC, this remastered masterpiece is the absolute best version of The Outer Worlds.

item.title: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin
item.description: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

item.title: DARK SOULS™: REMASTERED
item.description: Then, there was fire. Re-experience the critically acclaimed, genre-defining game that started it all. Beautifully remastered, return to Lordran in stunning high-definition detail running at 60fps.

item.title: Farming Camp
item.description: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

item.title: FRUKT
item.description: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

item.title: American Truck Simulator - Illinois
item.description: Welcome to the beautiful Prairie State! Illinois showcases the best of what the USA has to offer. Hop into your rig, hit the legendary Route 66, and journey through Springfield, the state’s historic capital, to Chicago, one of the Midwest's most iconic cities.

item.title: HIROTONFA’s American Revolution Smuggler
item.description: Date a state! Buy low, sell high, dodge the Royal Navy and Patriot Privateers, and romance colonial state-chans in a chaotic American Revolution merchant sim. Mercantilism ho!

item.title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
item.description: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

item.title: Monastery: Ora et Labora
item.description: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

item.title: REMATCH - NV Infrared Bundle
item.description: Stock up on Quants and look the part while you're at it.
